admitted_r1b_fact: Transparent content inherits the containing part of the parent content model iteratively.
Only an option with no label and no datalist ancestor admits zero or more div elements or phrasing content; label/datalist branches do not admit div.
Outside head, noscript is transparent only when scripting is disabled; enabled scripting changes both parsing and content semantics.
An autonomous custom element has phrasing context and transparent content, but source hyphen syntax alone does not establish that an element is an autonomous custom element.
